name: Get Questionnaires from non terminated actions
description: Get the questionnaires of the not completed workflow actions of the given action type on an incident or request

action_type_id.description: Numeric action type ID from EasyVista administration; not a GUID
action_type_id.title: Action Type Id

record_count.description: Number of items (**integer**, unlike the string counts of the list endpoints)

results.description: Items returned unchanged: REQUEST_ID, ACTION_ID, ACTION_TYPE_ID, WORKFLOW_ID (strings) and QUESTION_LIST_ID (string or null). Results may contain duplicates and are not filtered. To read a questionnaire, use the EasyVista GET /questionnaires/{QUESTION_LIST_ID} endpoint; this module does not expose that operation.
